opening.argument: The clearest guidance to viewers is caution: the video warns against investing or depositing, says payment may not arrive, and expressly declines to guarantee earnings, payouts, or the platform’s legitimacy. It presents a purported free Litecoin-mining service in that educational context, even as the displayed site advertises passive income and shows a requirement for receiving payment. No completed deposit, withdrawal, or loss is shown. The shortened links and Telegram giveaway request are separate contextual details; the record does not establish their destinations, terms, safety, or outcomes. Those limits matter when assessing the presentation as a whole.
